$comment: The vertical 9:16 (Instagram Reels / TikTok) version: pass --pipeline=src/pipeline.vertical.json to the scripts (?pipeline= in the page). Same song data and fps as src/pipeline.json; its own page size, scene registry (src/scenes-vertical/index.js, which each project writes) and master (out/music-video-vertical.mp4). tailSeconds 0.3 is an example default: set it per song so the song plus the tail stays under 180 s, the Instagram Reels 3:00 cap (a song of 180 s or more has to be cut down for Reels); 0 is fine when the vertical cut doesn't need the landscape tail. render.scale 1: the master is 1080x1920.
